title: Rainforest layers diagram sheet
subject: Geography
source: Seeded from geography/y3 lesson 6 (Rainforest layers diagram sheet (portal printable))
intro: Lesson 6: The layers of the rainforest. To understand how the rainforest is made of layers with different light and life

picture.draw: Draw and label: Rainforest layers diagram sheet

questions.q: Put the layers in order from the top.
questions.model: Start at the very top: emergent. Then the roof of leaves: canopy. Then the dim middle: understorey. Last, the ground: forest floor.

questions.q: Where do most rainforest animals live?
Core: Draw and label the four layers. Add one fact about each.
questions.a: Four labelled layers with facts such as: emergent, tallest trees; canopy, most animals; understorey, dim; forest floor, dark and leafy
questions.model: Teacher shows it first: draw the tall emergent tree, write 'emergent: tallest trees, over 50 m'.

questions.q: Extend: Add an arrow showing where the light comes from and how it gets less.
questions.a: An arrow from the top getting thinner towards the floor

questions.q: Stretch: Why do fallen leaves rot quickly on the forest floor?
questions.a: It is hot and wet, so tiny living things break them down fast

questions.q: Big question: why does each layer of the rainforest feel like a different world?
questions.a: Each layer gets a different amount of light, so different plants and animals live there
